comparison.objective: Move an iron to the right end of a mat and leave it safely standing on its heel.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe grasp, transport, reorientation, and stable placement of a weighted appliance.
comparison.success_condition: Iron upright on its heel in the target region and stationary; dropping or leaving it face-down on the bare mat fails.
comparison.reason: Single-object transport and stable orientation are unrelated to selective media recovery and bridge-clearing.
